mapper.update: CREATE TABLE ${TNAME} ( SEQ NUMBER(11) NOT NULL, CHANNEL VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL, CALLBACK VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL, USE_YN VARCHAR2(1), REG_DATE DATE, REG_ID VARCHAR2(12), MOD_TIME DATE, MOD_ID VARCHAR2(12), REMARK VARCHAR2(100), CONSTRAINT PK_${tableName} PRIMARY KEY ( SEQ ) )
CREATE SEQUENCE ${tableName}_SEQ START WITH 1 MAXVALUE 99999999 MINVALUE 1 CYCLE CACHE 20 NOORDER;
mapper.select: SELECT SEQ AS sequence, CHANNEL, CALLBACK, USE_YN, REG_DATE AS registration_time, REG_ID AS registration_id, MOD_DATE AS modification_date, MOD_ID AS modification_id, REMARK FROM ${tableName} WHERE USE_YN = #{parameter.useYn} AND CHANNEL = #{parameter.channel} AND CALLBACK = #{parameter.phone}
